name: 1991 Oakland Hills (Tunnel) fire (Hiller Highlands, Upper Rockridge, Grizzly Peak / Claremont Canyon, Broadway Terrace)
note: A fire, not a planned clearance: on Sunday 20 Oct 1991 a rekindled grass fire above the Caldecott Tunnel was driven by Diablo winds through the Oakland and Berkeley hills; 2,843 single-family houses and 437 apartment and condominium units were destroyed and 25 people died (USFA TR-060; Wikipedia). Ring = the CAL FIRE FRAP perimeter 'TUNNEL' 1991 (firep, OBJECTID 10631; 1,623 GIS acres), simplified to 25 m. Date EXACT (day of the firestorm; FRAP's alarm date reads 22 Oct), extent MEDIUM-HIGH (agency perimeter; a few houses inside survived — buildings with recorded pre-fire years keep them). pipeline/fires.py clearance_predecessors: every building dated 1992-2006 inside stands on the outline of a house that burned (procedural, from the neighbourhood's recorded pre-fire years).
